# ARTICLE 7 — COVENANTS OF MORTGAGOR

Mortgagor covenants and agrees with Mortgagee as follows, at all times from the Closing Date until the Indebtedness is paid in full and this Mortgage is released of record:

**7.1 Compliance with Laws.** Mortgagor shall comply, and shall cause the Property to be used and operated in compliance, with all applicable federal, state, county and municipal laws, statutes, ordinances, codes, rules, regulations, orders and permits, including all zoning, building, fire, life-safety, accessibility, health and Environmental Laws, and all requirements of the City of Charleston Board of Architectural Review applicable to the Property. Mortgagor shall promptly deliver to Mortgagee copies of any notice of violation, citation, order or directive received from any Governmental Authority relating to the Property within five (5) Business Days after receipt.

**7.2 Maintenance and Repairs; Waste.** Mortgagor shall keep and maintain the Property, including all Improvements, fixtures, building systems, structural elements, roof, façade, common areas and appurtenances, in good order, condition and repair, and in a condition consistent with that of comparable mixed-use commercial properties in the Charleston, South Carolina metropolitan area, and shall make all repairs and replacements necessary for that purpose and for compliance with all applicable laws. Mortgagor shall not commit or permit any waste of the Property or any portion thereof, and shall not remove, demolish or materially alter any Improvement without Mortgagee's prior written consent (except as contemplated by the Project). Mortgagor shall not abandon the Property, shall keep the Property fully insured as required by **Article 8**, and shall maintain uninterrupted utility service to the Property.

**7.3 Leasing Covenant and Lease Approvals.** Mortgagor shall use commercially reasonable efforts to lease all vacant space at the Property at market rents and on terms consistent with those prevailing for comparable mixed-use commercial properties in the Charleston metropolitan area and reasonably acceptable to Mortgagee. Without Mortgagee's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed, Mortgagor shall not (a) enter into or modify any Lease (i) covering more than 5,000 square feet of space or (ii) having a term (including renewal options exercisable at the Tenant's option) exceeding five (5) years; (b) enter into any Lease that contains any right of first refusal, right of first offer, option to expand, option to purchase, right of termination (other than a customary termination right arising from casualty or Condemnation), co-tenancy condition or exclusive use provision; (c) accept any prepayment of Rent more than one (1) month in advance; (d) grant any rent abatement or free rent exceeding three (3) months in the aggregate, or grant any tenant improvement allowance, or pay any leasing commission, other than in accordance with the Approved Renovation Budget or the Tenant Improvement and Leasing Commission Reserve; (e) accept the surrender of any Lease or consent to any assignment or subletting by a Tenant, other than as contemplated by the applicable Lease; or (f) release, reduce or apply any Tenant's security deposit other than in accordance with the applicable Lease. Mortgagor shall deliver to Mortgagee, together with each request for consent, a proposed lease abstract and such financial information regarding the proposed Tenant as Mortgagee may reasonably request.

**7.3A Interface with Tenant Right of First Refusal.** Mortgagor acknowledges that the Lease with Harmon & Wren Design Studio LLC grants that Tenant a right of first refusal with respect to Bay 2 (3,800 square feet), exercisable within fifteen (15) business days after presentation of a bona fide third-party offer, and that such right survives renewal of the Tenant's Lease. Because Mortgagor may not lease Bay 2 without complying with that right, Mortgagor shall, before presenting any third-party offer to such Tenant, obtain Mortgagee's written approval of all of the material terms of the proposed third-party lease (to the extent such approval is required under **Section 7.3**), and shall deliver to Mortgagee a copy of any offer presented to such Tenant, any exercise or waiver of the right of first refusal, and any resulting Lease, in each case within five (5) Business Days. Mortgagor acknowledges that Mortgagee's approval of the terms of a proposed third-party lease shall not obligate Mortgagee to approve any Lease subsequently entered into with such Tenant at different terms. Nothing in this Section 7.3A shall be construed to expand or validate the scope of the Tenant's right of first refusal beyond its terms as disclosed in the Rent Roll.

**7.4 Single-Purpose Entity and Separateness Covenants.** Mortgagor shall at all times maintain its status as a single-purpose, bankruptcy-remote entity and shall comply with the following covenants, which are in addition to the covenants set forth in Section 10.1 of the Term Sheet:

**(a) Single purpose.** Mortgagor shall not engage in any business or activity other than the ownership, acquisition, holding, operation, renovation, leasing, management, financing and disposition of the Property and activities incidental thereto, and shall not acquire or own any asset other than the Property and the assets incidental to its ownership and operation.

**(b) Separate books, records and accounts.** Mortgagor shall maintain its own separate books of account, accounting records, minute books, financial statements and bank accounts, separate and apart from those of any other Person, and shall not commingle its funds or assets with those of any member, manager, Affiliate or other Person.

**(c) Corporate formalities and identity.** Mortgagor shall hold itself out to the public, and to all creditors and contractual counterparties, as a legal entity separate and distinct from any other Person, shall conduct its business exclusively in its own name, shall use its own stationery, invoices, purchase orders and checks, and shall not use the letterhead or identity of any Affiliate.

**(d) Arm's-length dealings.** Mortgagor shall maintain arm's-length relationships with each Related Entity, and any transaction, contract or arrangement between Mortgagor and any Related Entity shall be on commercially reasonable terms and shall be disclosed in writing to Mortgagee.

**(e) No guarantees; no affiliate obligations.** Mortgagor shall not guarantee or otherwise become obligated for the debts or obligations of any Related Entity or any other Person, and shall not pledge its assets or credit for the benefit of any Related Entity.

**(f) Own liabilities.** Mortgagor shall pay its own liabilities and expenses from its own funds and assets, and shall not pay the liabilities of any Related Entity or any other Person.

**(g) Adequate capitalization.** Mortgagor shall maintain adequate capital in light of its contemplated business operations, consistent with **Section 7.8**.

**(h) No dissolution, merger or bankruptcy without independent approval.** Mortgagor shall not, without the prior written consent of Mortgagee and the affirmative vote of its independent manager or independent director, (i) file a voluntary petition under the United States Bankruptcy Code or any state insolvency law, (ii) consent to the filing of an involuntary petition against it, (iii) dissolve, wind up, liquidate, merge, consolidate or sell all or substantially all of its assets, (iv) make an assignment for the benefit of creditors, or (v) admit in writing its inability to pay its debts generally as they become due.

**(i) No amendment of SPE provisions.** Mortgagor shall not amend, modify, waive, terminate or repeal any SPE provision of its operating agreement or certificate of formation, or take any action inconsistent with such provisions, without Mortgagee's prior written consent in each instance, and shall promptly deliver to Mortgagee a copy of each amendment to its organizational documents.

**(j) Member consent.** Mortgagor shall cause each of its members (Graydon Development Group LLC, Tidewater Opportunity Fund II LP and Harborline Capital Advisors LLC), and Tidewater GP Holdings LLC, as general partner of Tidewater Opportunity Fund II LP, to acknowledge and agree in writing, in form satisfactory to Mortgagee, to be bound by the SPE Covenants and the transfer restrictions set forth in **Section 7.5**, and shall deliver such acknowledgments, joinders and authorizations (including evidence of the authority of Tidewater GP Holdings LLC to bind Tidewater Opportunity Fund II LP) as a condition to closing and upon the admission of any new member.

**(k) Independent manager maintenance.** Mortgagor shall at all times maintain an independent manager or independent director meeting Mortgagee's requirements and shall not permit any vacancy in that position to continue for more than ten (10) Business Days.

**7.5 Transfer Restrictions.**

**(a) Property.** Mortgagor shall not, without Mortgagee's prior written consent, sell, convey, transfer, assign, exchange, lease (other than Leases permitted under **Section 7.3**), option, pledge, mortgage, hypothecate, encumber or otherwise dispose of the Property or any portion thereof or any interest therein, whether voluntarily, involuntarily, by operation of law or otherwise.

**(b) Interests in Mortgagor.** Mortgagor shall not permit any transfer, sale, assignment, pledge, hypothecation, encumbrance, gift, devise, or other disposition of any membership interest in Mortgagor (each, a "**Transfer**") that (i) exceeds ten percent (10%) of the membership interests in Mortgagor individually, or (ii) together with all other Transfers, exceeds twenty-five percent (25%) of the membership interests in Mortgagor in the aggregate, determined from the Closing Date, without Mortgagee's prior written consent. Transfers among the existing members of Mortgagor (Graydon Development Group LLC, Tidewater Opportunity Fund II LP and Harborline Capital Advisors LLC) that do not result in a change of Control of Mortgagor shall not require Mortgagee's consent, *provided* that Mortgagor gives Mortgagee at least fifteen (15) Business Days' prior written notice and delivers such documentation as Mortgagee may reasonably request, and *provided further* that no such Transfer may result in Mortgagor ceasing to be a single-purpose entity or in any change in the identity of the Managing Member.

**(c) Indirect and upstream transfers.** Any change in Control of Mortgagor, of Graydon Development Group LLC, or of any Person that Controls Mortgagor, whether effected by transfer of equity interests, by merger, by the admission or withdrawal of a general partner or managing member, by the grant of a proxy or voting agreement, or otherwise, shall be deemed a Transfer requiring Mortgagee's prior written consent. Without limiting the foregoing, Mortgagor shall not permit (i) any transfer of the membership interest of Graydon Development Group LLC in Mortgagor, (ii) any transfer of the direct or indirect ownership interest in Graydon Development Group LLC held by Guarantor, or (iii) any transfer of the membership interest of Tidewater Opportunity Fund II LP in Mortgagor to any successor fund or other entity managed by or affiliated with Tidewater GP Holdings LLC, unless, in each case, Mortgagee has consented in writing.

**(d) Conforming amendment.** Mortgagor shall, on or before the Closing Date, cause its operating agreement to be amended so that the transfer restrictions contained in its operating agreement conform to this **Section 7.5** and to Section 10.3 of the Term Sheet, including by eliminating any "permitted transfer" that would permit a Transfer prohibited by this Section, and shall deliver a copy of the executed amendment to Mortgagee.

**(e) No cure.** Any Transfer in violation of this Section 7.5 shall constitute an immediate Event of Default, without notice or opportunity to cure, and shall entitle Mortgagee to exercise all remedies under **Article 13**, including acceleration, imposition of the Default Rate and judicial foreclosure. Any Transfer made in violation of this Section shall be void *ab initio* at Mortgagee's election.

**7.6 Environmental Compliance; Land Use Restriction.**

**(a) General compliance.** Mortgagor shall comply, and shall cause the Property and each Tenant and contractor at the Property to comply, in all material respects with all Environmental Laws. Mortgagor shall not cause or permit any Hazardous Materials to be generated, used, stored, treated, transported, released, discharged, disposed of or threatened to be released at, on, under or from the Property, except for customary cleaning supplies and office products used in the ordinary course of the operation of the Property in compliance with Environmental Laws and in de minimis quantities.

**(b) Notice and reporting.** Mortgagor shall notify Mortgagee in writing within three (3) Business Days after Mortgagor obtains knowledge of (i) any release, discharge, spill or disposal of Hazardous Materials at, on, under or from the Property, (ii) any violation or alleged violation of any Environmental Law or of the Land Use Restriction, (iii) any inspection, investigation, notice of violation, information request, order, directive or enforcement action by SCDHEC, the United States Environmental Protection Agency or any other Governmental Authority relating to the Property, or (iv) any claim, demand or action by any Person relating to Hazardous Materials or the Land Use Restriction, and shall deliver copies of all related correspondence, reports and sampling data to Mortgagee within five (5) Business Days after receipt or transmittal.

**(c) Land Use Restriction — specific covenants.** Mortgagor acknowledges that the Land Use Restriction is a covenant running with the land, is binding on Mortgagor and all Tenants, successors and assigns, and is a condition to the continuing effectiveness of SCDHEC's No Further Action determination for SCDHEC Site ID SC-29403-0772. Mortgagor therefore covenants that:

> **(i)** Mortgagor shall not use, and shall not permit any Tenant or other Person to use, the ground floor of Lot 7 (Tax Map No. 460-12-04-007; comprised of Bay 1, 520 King Street, containing approximately 3,800 square feet) for residential purposes, and shall not convert such space to a residential use, and shall not enter into any Lease or occupancy agreement for such space that permits residential use or any use inconsistent with the Land Use Restriction;
>
> **(ii)** Mortgagor shall maintain, repair, preserve and keep in good condition and working order the vapor barrier system installed beneath the concrete floor slab of Bay 1, and shall not penetrate, remove, breach, compromise or render ineffective any portion of such vapor barrier;
>
> **(iii)** Mortgagor shall not perform or permit any renovation, construction, demolition, alteration, repair or other work that penetrates, disturbs or is reasonably likely to compromise the vapor barrier beneath the Bay 1 slab, or that otherwise affects the Bay 1 slab, unless (A) Mortgagor has given prior written notice to SCDHEC and to Mortgagee in accordance with the Land Use Restriction, (B) a qualified, licensed environmental professional has inspected the vapor barrier before and after such work and has certified to Mortgagee that the vapor barrier remains intact and effective, or has repaired or replaced the same in accordance with SCDHEC requirements, and (C) Mortgagor has delivered a copy of such inspection and certification report to Mortgagee promptly, and in any event before any Draw is requested for the affected work;
>
> **(iv)** Mortgagor shall cause each contractor, subcontractor, architect, construction manager and consultant performing work at the Property (including Beaufort Builders Group LLC under the GC Contract) to be informed in writing of the existence, location and function of the vapor barrier and of the requirements of the Land Use Restriction, and shall incorporate an express covenant of compliance with the Land Use Restriction into the GC Contract and into each other construction contract;
>
> **(v)** Mortgagor shall comply with all terms, conditions and obligations of the Land Use Restriction and all requirements, directives and orders of SCDHEC relating to SCDHEC Site ID SC-29403-0772, including all inspection, reporting, notification, access and institutional-control obligations, and shall make all filings and pay all fees required by SCDHEC in connection therewith;
>
> **(vi)** Mortgagor shall not amend, modify, terminate, release, transfer, waive or seek the modification, termination, release or transfer of the Land Use Restriction, or seek any change in the SCDHEC No Further Action determination or SCDHEC Site ID SC-29403-0772, without Mortgagee's prior written consent in each instance;
>
> **(vii)** Mortgagor shall deliver to Mortgagee, on or before the Closing Date and thereafter within thirty (30) days after the end of each calendar year (and more frequently upon Mortgagee's request following an Event of Default), a certificate executed by Mortgagor, together with a compliance report from a licensed environmental professional reasonably acceptable to Mortgagee, certifying that (A) the ground floor of Lot 7 has not been used for residential purposes, (B) the vapor barrier remains intact and in good condition and working order, (C) Mortgagor is in full compliance with the Land Use Restriction, and (D) no notice of violation, non-compliance or reopening of the SCDHEC site file has been received; and
>
> **(viii)** Mortgagor shall cooperate fully with any inspection, review or inquiry by SCDHEC and shall permit Mortgagee and its consultants, upon reasonable prior notice (and without notice following an Event of Default), to inspect the Property and review Mortgagor's books and records relating to compliance with the Land Use Restriction.

**(d) Environmental Indemnity.** Mortgagor's obligations under this **Section 7.6** are in addition to, and not in limitation of, its obligations under the Environmental Indemnity Agreement, which obligations survive repayment of the Loan, foreclosure, the delivery of a deed in lieu of foreclosure and the release of this Mortgage as provided therein. Nothing in this Mortgage shall limit any right or remedy of Mortgagee under the Environmental Indemnity Agreement.

**(e) No invasive investigation without consent.** Mortgagor shall not cause or permit any Phase II environmental site assessment, subsurface investigation, soil or groundwater sampling, or other invasive environmental testing at the Property, and shall not conduct any remediation, without Mortgagee's prior written consent, except (i) as required by Environmental Law or by any Governmental Authority pursuant to a written order, or (ii) as necessary to respond to an emergency. Mortgagor shall deliver copies of all reports and data generated by any such activity to Mortgagee within five (5) Business Days after receipt.

**(f) Event of Default.** Notwithstanding any other provision of this Mortgage or any cure period provided in Section 11.2 of the Term Sheet, any failure by Mortgagor to comply with the Land Use Restriction, or any amendment, modification, termination, transfer or release of the Land Use Restriction, or any use of the ground floor of Lot 7 for residential purposes, or any penetration, removal or compromise of the vapor barrier beneath the Bay 1 slab without satisfaction of the conditions in Section 7.6(c)(iii), shall constitute an immediate Event of Default, without notice or opportunity to cure, in accordance with the Title Insurer's special instruction to closer and Section 5 of this Mortgage.

**7.7 Renovation Covenants.** Mortgagor shall (a) commence the Project promptly following the Closing Date and in any event within sixty (60) days thereafter; (b) prosecute the Project with diligence and continuity and achieve Substantial Completion on or before the Substantial Completion Deadline; (c) perform the Project in accordance with the Approved Renovation Budget, the Plans and Specifications and all applicable permits and approvals, including any approval of the Board of Architectural Review of the City of Charleston; (d) cause the Project to be performed by Beaufort Builders Group LLC under the GC Contract, and not terminate, replace, assign or materially amend the GC Contract, and not approve or permit any change order, change directive or contract sum increase that individually exceeds $50,000 or that, together with all other change orders, exceeds $100,000 in the aggregate, without Mortgagee's prior written consent; (e) deliver to Mortgagee, within ten (10) days after the end of each calendar month during the Project, a written construction progress report, together with the then-current schedule of values, a comparison of actual costs to the Approved Renovation Budget, and notice of any known or anticipated cost overrun; (f) pay when due all costs of the Project in excess of the Renovation Holdback, including the Borrower Equity Contribution and any and all cost overruns, from Mortgagor's own funds; (g) obtain and maintain builder's risk insurance as required by **Article 8** and cause Beaufort Builders Group LLC to maintain the insurance required by the GC Contract; and (h) deliver to Mortgagee, promptly upon Substantial Completion, an architect's certificate of Substantial Completion, the certificate of occupancy, final lien waivers from the general contractor and all subcontractors and materialmen, and the final title date-down endorsement contemplated by Section 8.4 of the Term Sheet.

**7.8 Financial Covenants.**

**(a) Debt Service Coverage Ratio.** Mortgagor shall maintain a Debt Service Coverage Ratio of not less than 1.25 to 1.00. The Debt Service Coverage Ratio shall be tested as of the last day of each calendar quarter, commencing with the calendar quarter ending June 30, 2027 (being the first full calendar quarter ending after the twenty-fourth (24th) month following the Closing Date, as provided in Section 7.1 of the Term Sheet), and continuing quarterly thereafter. "**Debt Service Coverage Ratio**" means, for any testing period, the quotient obtained by dividing (i) Net Operating Income for the twelve (12) consecutive full calendar months ending on the last day of such testing period, by (ii) the aggregate amount of all regularly scheduled payments of principal and interest that are payable under the Note during the twelve (12) consecutive months immediately following the last day of such testing period (determined on the basis of the principal balance then outstanding, the Applicable Rate in effect on the last day of the testing period and the amortization schedule then in effect), whether or not any such payment is payable on an interest-only basis. If the principal balance outstanding on the last day of the testing period differs from the principal balance expected to be outstanding during the following twelve months by reason of scheduled Draws, the calculation shall assume that all undrawn portions of the Renovation Holdback have been fully disbursed.

**(b) Mortgagor net worth and liquidity.** Mortgagor shall maintain at all times (i) a net worth of not less than $1,000,000 and (ii) liquid assets (consisting of cash, cash equivalents, marketable securities and unencumbered deposits held at federally insured depository institutions) of not less than $500,000. Compliance shall be tested annually, as of the end of each fiscal year, based on the financial statements and certification delivered under **Section 7.9**.

**(c) Guarantor net worth and liquidity.** Guarantor shall maintain at all times (i) a net worth of not less than $1,000,000 and (ii) liquid assets of not less than $500,000, in each case tested annually on the basis of the annual personal financial statement delivered under **Section 7.9(b)**. Mortgagor shall cause Guarantor to comply with this Section 7.8(c), and any failure of Guarantor to comply shall constitute an Event of Default under this Mortgage.

**(d) Calculation and disputes.** All calculations under this Section 7.8 shall be made by Mortgagee on the basis of the financial statements and certificates delivered under **Section 7.9** and Mortgagee's customary underwriting standards, and shall be conclusive absent manifest error. Mortgagor may, within fifteen (15) Business Days after written notice of a determination that a covenant has not been satisfied, deliver a written objection together with supporting calculations, in which case the parties shall consult in good faith; no such objection shall suspend Mortgagee's rights if the failure remains uncured after the applicable cure period, if any.

**7.9 Financial Statements and Reporting.** Mortgagor shall deliver, or cause to be delivered, to Mortgagee:

**(a)** within one hundred twenty (120) days after the end of each fiscal year of Mortgagor, audited annual financial statements of Mortgagor prepared in accordance with GAAP by an independent certified public accounting firm acceptable to Mortgagee, together with the consolidating and entity-level schedules customarily provided;

**(b)** within one hundred twenty (120) days after the end of each calendar year, an annual personal financial statement of Guarantor, in form and detail satisfactory to Mortgagee, certified by Guarantor as true, correct and complete;

**(c)** within thirty (30) days after the end of each calendar quarter, a rent roll for the Property, certified by Mortgagor as true, correct and complete, together with a schedule of security deposits held, a delinquency report and a report of all Leases executed, amended, renewed, terminated or surrendered during such quarter;

**(d)** within one hundred twenty (120) days after the end of each fiscal year of Mortgagor, annual property operating statements for the Property, including a detailed income and expense report and a comparison to the approved annual budget;

**(e)** within ten (10) Business Days after execution, copies of all Leases, lease amendments, renewals, extensions, terminations, surrenders, side letters and guaranties affecting the Property;

**(f)** concurrently with each quarterly delivery under clause (c), a compliance certificate executed by Mortgagor calculating the Debt Service Coverage Ratio (when applicable) and certifying compliance with **Section 7.8** and the other covenants in this Article 7;

**(g)** within thirty (30) days after the end of each calendar year, the annual certificate and vapor barrier compliance report required by Section 7.6(c)(vii);

**(h)** promptly upon Mortgagee's request, copies of all real property tax bills and receipts, all utility bills, all insurance certificates and premium statements, and such other information regarding the Property, Mortgagor, Guarantor or any Related Entity as Mortgagee may reasonably request; and

**(i)** promptly, and in any event within five (5) Business Days, written notice of (i) any Event of Default or any event that with notice or lapse of time would constitute an Event of Default, (ii) any default by any Tenant under a Lease that involves more than 5,000 square feet or more than three (3) months of rent, (iii) the bankruptcy or insolvency of any Tenant occupying more than 5,000 square feet, (iv) any litigation, arbitration or governmental proceeding involving Mortgagor, Guarantor, any Related Entity or the Property that involves more than $250,000 or that seeks injunctive relief affecting the Property, (v) any Condemnation or casualty affecting the Property, and (vi) any change in the identity of Mortgagor's managing member, officers, registered agent or principal place of business.

**7.10 Organizational Documents; Further Assurances.** Mortgagor shall not amend, restate, modify or replace its certificate of formation or operating agreement in any manner that adversely affects Mortgagee, that changes its name, jurisdiction or type of organization, or that modifies any SPE provision or transfer restriction, without Mortgagee's prior written consent. Mortgagor shall execute, acknowledge and deliver such further instruments, UCC filings, estoppel certificates, subordination agreements, consents, resolutions, certificates of good standing, opinions of counsel and other documents, and shall take such further actions, as Mortgagee may reasonably request to carry out the purposes of this Mortgage, to perfect or confirm the Lien of this Mortgage, or to facilitate its foreclosure or enforcement.

**7.11 No Additional Financing; No Liens.** Mortgagor shall not incur, create, assume or permit to exist any indebtedness for borrowed money, whether secured or unsecured, direct or contingent, or any lease obligations required to be capitalized under GAAP, other than (a) the Indebtedness, (b) trade payables and ordinary course operating obligations incurred in the operation of the Property and not more than sixty (60) days past due, and (c) purchase-money financing for equipment approved in advance in writing by Mortgagee. Mortgagor shall not create, incur, assume or permit to exist any Lien on the Property or any Collateral other than the Permitted Exceptions and the Lien of this Mortgage, and shall not incur, create or permit to exist any mezzanine loan, preferred equity investment or other financing arrangement that is secured, directly or indirectly, by any direct or indirect interest in Mortgagor.

**7.12 Operating Accounts; No Commingling.** Mortgagor shall maintain its operating accounts at one or more federally insured depository institutions, in its own name and separate from the accounts of any Related Entity, and shall deposit all Rents and other income from the Property into such accounts. Mortgagor shall not commingle its funds with those of any Related Entity, and shall not use any Escrow Fund for any purpose other than as expressly permitted by the applicable Loan Document.

**7.13 Access and Inspection.** Mortgagor shall permit Mortgagee and its agents, appraisers, engineers, environmental consultants, inspectors and accountants, upon not less than two (2) Business Days' prior notice (except in the case of an emergency or during the continuance of an Event of Default, in which case no notice shall be required), to enter upon and inspect the Property, to examine and copy Mortgagor's books and records relating to the Property, and to conduct such appraisals, physical needs assessments, environmental reviews and construction inspections as Mortgagee may reasonably require. All inspections and reports shall be at Mortgagor's expense to the extent provided in Section 13.2 of the Term Sheet. Mortgagee shall have no liability for any inspection or failure to inspect, and no inspection shall constitute a waiver of any Default or a representation by Mortgagee as to the condition of the Property.

**7.14 Anti-Terrorism; OFAC.** Mortgagor shall comply, and shall cause Guarantor and each Related Entity to comply, with all applicable anti-money laundering, anti-corruption, anti-bribery and economic sanctions laws, and shall not permit the Property or the Loan to be used in any manner that would violate such laws. Mortgagor shall deliver such certifications, identifying information and source-of-funds documentation as Mortgagee may request from time to time to satisfy its regulatory obligations, including under the Bank Secrecy Act and the USA PATRIOT Act.

**7.15 ERISA.** Mortgagor shall not become, and shall not permit any member to become, an "employee benefit plan" or "plan" subject to Title I of ERISA or Section 4975 of the Internal Revenue Code, and shall not take any action that would cause the Property to constitute "plan assets."

**7.16 Preservation of Permits, Easements and Encroachment Rights.** Mortgagor shall maintain in full force and effect all permits, licenses, certificates of occupancy, approvals and easements necessary for the use, occupancy and operation of the Property, including the utility easement recorded in Deed Book 987, Page 112, in the RMC Office, and shall not modify, relocate, release, abandon or fail to renew any of the same without Mortgagee's prior written consent. Mortgagor shall use commercially reasonable efforts to obtain and thereafter maintain in effect any encroachment license, franchise, permit or other authorization from the City of Charleston required for the decorative iron balcony extending approximately two and one-half (2.5) feet over the King Street public right-of-way, shall deliver copies of all applications, correspondence and approvals to Mortgagee, and shall notify Mortgagee within five (5) Business Days after receipt of any notice from the City of Charleston concerning such encroachment. Mortgagor shall not remove, alter or permit the removal or alteration of the balcony except in accordance with the Plans and Specifications and any approval required by the Board of Architectural Review.

**7.17 Preservation of Collateral.** Mortgagor shall keep the Collateral in good condition and repair, shall not remove any material item of Collateral from the Property except in the ordinary course of business for repair or replacement with items of equal or greater value and utility, and shall not sell, lease, transfer or otherwise dispose of any Collateral other than inventory and obsolete equipment disposed of in the ordinary course of business. Mortgagor shall promptly notify Mortgagee of any loss, damage, destruction or theft of any material item of Collateral.

**7.18 Guarantor Obligations.** Mortgagor shall cause Guarantor to perform all of Guarantor's obligations under the Guaranty Agreement, the Completion Guaranty and the Environmental Indemnity Agreement, and shall not permit Guarantor to transfer, encumber or dispose of any material portion of Guarantor's assets except in the ordinary course of business or as permitted under the Guaranty Agreement.

# ARTICLE 15 — INTEREST, FEES, LATE CHARGES AND PAYMENTS

**15.1 Payments; Interest-Only Period; Amortization.** Mortgagor shall pay the Indebtedness in accordance with the Note. Without limiting the Note, and subject to the Note in the event of any conflict: (a) the Loan shall bear interest at the Applicable Rate; (b) the Loan shall be interest-only for the first twenty-four (24) months following the Closing Date, commencing with the first Payment Date and ending on or about April 15, 2027, and during the Interest-Only Period monthly payments shall consist solely of accrued interest on the outstanding principal balance; (c) commencing with the payment due on May 15, 2027, and continuing through the Maturity Date, monthly payments of principal and interest shall be due based on a twenty-five (25) year amortization schedule, calculated on the then-outstanding principal balance and the then-applicable interest rate; (d) all payments of principal and interest shall be due on the fifteenth (15th) day of each calendar month, commencing May 15, 2025 (each, a "**Payment Date**"); and (e) the entire outstanding principal balance, together with all accrued and unpaid interest and all other amounts due under the Loan Documents, shall be due and payable on the Maturity Date.

**15.2 Interest Computation.** Interest on the Loan shall be computed on the basis of the actual number of days elapsed over a year of three hundred sixty (360) days. Interest shall accrue daily on the outstanding principal balance and shall be payable monthly in arrears on each Payment Date, at maturity, upon acceleration and upon prepayment, in each case for the period for which interest has not previously been paid. Any change in the Applicable Rate resulting from a change in Daily SOFR shall become effective on the day of such change, without notice to Mortgagor.

**15.3 Default Rate.** Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, the outstanding principal balance of the Loan and all other amounts due shall bear interest at the Default Rate, being the Applicable Rate plus five percent (5.00%) per annum, from the date of the Event of Default until the earlier of the date on which the Event of Default is cured or the Indebtedness is repaid in full. Interest at the Default Rate shall be payable on demand and shall be secured by this Mortgage. Mortgagee's imposition of the Default Rate shall not constitute a waiver of the Event of Default or an election of remedies, and the Default Rate shall continue to accrue whether or not Mortgagee has accelerated the Indebtedness.

**15.4 Late Charge.** If any installment of principal or interest, or any other amount payable under the Loan Documents, is not received by Mortgagee within ten (10) calendar days after its due date, Mortgagor shall pay to Mortgagee a late charge equal to five percent (5.00%) of the overdue amount (the "**Late Charge**"). Mortgagee may assess the Late Charge with respect to any overdue amount, and the Late Charge may be assessed more than once on the same amount if it remains overdue in more than one month. Mortgagor acknowledges and agrees that the Late Charge is intended to compensate Mortgagee for the additional administrative expense, processing cost and loss of use of funds occasioned by late payment; that the actual damages to Mortgagee from a late payment are extremely difficult and impractical to ascertain; that the Late Charge is a reasonable estimate of such damages; and that the Late Charge is not a penalty, is not interest and shall not reduce or be credited against any interest otherwise payable. The Late Charge is in addition to, and not in lieu of, the Default Rate and all other remedies.

**15.5 Application of Payments.** All payments received by Mortgagee shall be applied in such order as Mortgagee may elect and, absent such election, as provided in **Section 13.8**. Mortgagor hereby waives any right to direct the application of any payment. Any payment received after the applicable Event of Default shall be accepted without prejudice to Mortgagee's rights and may be applied as Mortgagee elects. If any payment is insufficient to pay all amounts then due, Mortgagee may apply it to any component of the Indebtedness in its discretion.

**15.6 Payments on Business Days; Manner of Payment.** If any Payment Date or other payment date is not a Business Day, the payment shall be due on the next succeeding Business Day, and interest shall continue to accrue for the intervening period. All payments shall be made in lawful money of the United States, in immediately available funds, without setoff, deduction, abatement, counterclaim or withholding, to Mortgagee at the address specified in **Section 18.1** or by wire transfer to the account designated by Mortgagee in writing.

**15.7 Fees, Costs and Expenses.** Mortgagor shall pay on the Closing Date (a) a loan origination fee equal to one percent (1.00%) of the Loan amount, in the amount of $147,500, which is fully earned upon closing and non-refundable under any circumstances; (b) all out-of-pocket costs and expenses incurred by Mortgagee in connection with the origination, underwriting, documentation, closing and administration of the Loan, including the reasonable legal fees and disbursements of Mortgagee's counsel, Fielding, Ashworth & Cole LLP; appraisal and appraisal review fees; environmental report fees; title insurance premiums and title search charges; the cost of the Survey; recording fees; UCC filing and search fees; construction inspection fees during the Project; and such other costs and expenses as Mortgagee may incur; and (c) subject to confirmation by the Title Insurer, all South Carolina documentary stamp taxes, deed recording fees and mortgage recording fees payable upon recording of this Mortgage, which, based on the rate of $1.85 per $500 of the indebtedness secured (0.37%), are estimated to be $54,575 with respect to the indebtedness of $14,750,000 secured hereby. Mortgagor shall additionally reimburse Mortgagee on demand for all such costs and expenses incurred after closing, including those described in **Section 13.11**. All such amounts shall be secured by this Mortgage and shall bear interest at the Default Rate if not paid within ten (10) days after demand.

**15.8 Interest Rate Limitation.** Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Mortgage, the Note or any other Loan Document, in no event shall the aggregate interest and other charges that are treated as interest under applicable law exceed the maximum lawful rate permitted under applicable law. If any amount in excess of the maximum lawful rate is paid, collected, charged or received, then (a) that amount shall be deemed not to have been paid or charged, shall be automatically reduced to the maximum lawful rate, and shall be refunded to Mortgagor or credited against the principal balance of the Loan as Mortgagor may elect in writing, and (b) any provision of the Loan Documents that conflicts with this Section shall be deemed reformed to the extent necessary to comply with the maximum lawful rate. To the extent permitted by applicable law, all amounts that are treated as interest shall be amortized, prorated, allocated and spread over the full period of the Loan.

**15.9 Payments Set Aside.** To the extent that any payment received by Mortgagee is subsequently invalidated, declared to be fraudulent or preferential, set aside, rescinded or required to be repaid to a trustee, receiver, debtor in possession, creditor, estate or any other Person under any bankruptcy, insolvency, fraudulent conveyance or similar law or under any equitable cause, then, to the extent of such payment, the obligation intended to be satisfied shall be revived and continue in full force and effect as if such payment had never been received, and this Mortgage shall remain in full force and effect with respect to such revived obligation.

**15.10 No Offset, Defense or Counterclaim.** Mortgagor acknowledges that its obligations under the Loan Documents are absolute, unconditional and independent of any other agreement or circumstance, and Mortgagor waives, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, any right to assert any offset, defense, counterclaim, abatement, deduction or recoupment in any action to enforce this Mortgage or to collect the Indebtedness, except to the extent arising from Mortgagee's gross negligence or willful misconduct as determined by a final, non-appealable judgment.

**15.11 Benchmark Replacement.** If Mortgagee determines in good faith that (a) Daily SOFR has been permanently or indefinitely discontinued or is no longer published or is otherwise unavailable, (b) the administrator of Daily SOFR or its supervisor has publicly announced that it will cease to provide Daily SOFR, or (c) Daily SOFR is no longer representative of the cost of overnight borrowing in the market, then Mortgagee may select a successor rate that is a forward-looking, risk-free or other recognized replacement benchmark rate for Dollar-denominated syndicated or commercial real estate loans (including term SOFR, compounded SOFR in arrears or a successor publication recommended by a relevant governmental or regulatory authority or industry working group), together with any applicable spread adjustment, conforming changes to the interest calculation conventions and any technical or procedural amendments that Mortgagee determines are appropriate. Mortgagee shall give Mortgagor not less than fifteen (15) days' prior written notice of any such selection and conforming changes, and any such replacement shall be effected by an amendment to the Note executed by Mortgagor and Mortgagee; if Mortgagor fails to execute such amendment within ten (10) days after request, Mortgagee may make the replacement effective by written notice to Mortgagor, and Mortgagor shall be bound thereby.

**15.12 Statements of Account.** Mortgagee shall deliver to Mortgagor, upon Mortgagor's written request not more frequently than once per calendar quarter, a statement of the outstanding principal balance, accrued interest and other amounts due under the Loan. Mortgagee's books and records shall be presumptively correct absent manifest error.

# ARTICLE 16 — PREPAYMENT

**16.1 Lockout Period — No Prepayment.** The Loan may not be prepaid in whole or in part at any time during the Lockout Period (the period from the Closing Date through the day immediately preceding the twenty-fourth (24th) monthly anniversary of the date of the Note). No voluntary prepayment of principal shall be permitted during the Lockout Period, and any attempted prepayment during the Lockout Period shall be void and of no effect and shall not discharge or reduce the Indebtedness; *provided* that the foregoing shall not limit the application of insurance proceeds or Condemnation awards in accordance with **Article 14**, which shall be applied at par without any prepayment premium, penalty or Yield Maintenance Premium.

**16.2 Yield Maintenance Period.** From the expiration of the Lockout Period through the forty-eighth (48th) monthly anniversary of the date of the Note (the "**Yield Maintenance Period**"), the Loan may be prepaid in whole, but not in part, upon not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Mortgagee, and upon payment, in addition to all other amounts due, of a prepayment premium (the "**Yield Maintenance Premium**") equal to the greater of:

> **(a)** one percent (1.00%) of the principal amount of the Loan being prepaid; and
>
> **(b)** the excess, if any, of (i) the present value, discounted monthly at the Treasury Rate, of the aggregate interest that would have accrued on the principal amount being prepaid during the period from the date of prepayment through the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period, computed at the rate per annum equal to the Note rate in effect on the date of prepayment, over (ii) the present value, discounted monthly at the Treasury Rate, of the aggregate interest that would have accrued on such principal amount during the same period, computed at a rate per annum equal to the Treasury Rate plus fifty (50) basis points (0.50%);
>
> *provided* that the amount determined under this clause (b) shall in no event be less than zero, and shall be zero if the Note rate in effect on the date of prepayment is less than or equal to the Treasury Rate plus fifty (50) basis points.

For purposes of this Section 16.2: (i) the "**Treasury Rate**" means the yield to maturity, as of the second (2nd) Business Day preceding the date of prepayment, of the United States Treasury security having a maturity date closest to, but not exceeding, the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period, as reported in Federal Reserve Statistical Release H.15 — Selected Interest Rates (or any successor publication) under the heading "Treasury Constant Maturities"; if the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period does not correspond exactly to a published maturity, the Treasury Rate shall be determined by linear interpolation between the yields reported for the two nearest published maturities (or, if the last day of the Yield Maintenance Period is later than the longest published maturity, the yield on the longest published maturity); (ii) discounting shall be computed monthly using a periodic rate equal to the Treasury Rate divided by twelve (12) and the number of whole and partial months remaining in the Yield Maintenance Period; (iii) if the Treasury Rate is not published for the applicable date, the Treasury Rate shall be determined on the basis of the most recent publication available, as reasonably determined by Mortgagee; and (iv) Mortgagee's computation of the Yield Maintenance Premium shall be conclusive absent manifest error and shall be set forth in a written calculation delivered to Mortgagor not less than five (5) Business Days prior to the date of prepayment.

**16.3 Open Prepayment Period.** During the final twelve (12) months of the term of the Loan (that is, from and after the forty-eighth (48th) monthly anniversary of the date of the Note through the Maturity Date), the Loan may be prepaid in whole or in part at any time and from time to time, without payment of any prepayment premium, penalty or yield maintenance amount, upon not less than fifteen (15) days' prior written notice to Mortgagee.

**16.4 Mechanics of Prepayment.** Each notice of prepayment shall be in writing, shall be irrevocable, shall specify the date and amount of the prepayment, and shall be accompanied by the payment, on the date specified, of the principal amount being prepaid together with all accrued and unpaid interest on the amount prepaid, the Yield Maintenance Premium (if applicable), the Late Charge and all other amounts then due under the Loan Documents. No prepayment shall be made on a date other than a Payment Date, and no partial prepayment shall be permitted during the Lockout Period or the Yield Maintenance Period. Any partial prepayment permitted under **Section 16.3** shall be in a minimum amount of $500,000 and in increments of $100,000 in excess thereof. All partial prepayments shall be applied to the installments of principal in the inverse order of their maturity, shall not reduce the amount of any monthly installment of principal and interest, shall not change the amortization schedule, and shall not change the Maturity Date.

**16.5 Involuntary Prepayments.** Any application of insurance proceeds or Condemnation awards to the Indebtedness under **Article 14**, and any application of Escrow Funds, Rents or other Collateral to the Indebtedness at any time when no Event of Default has occurred and is continuing, shall be made at par, without any prepayment premium, penalty or Yield Maintenance Premium.

**16.6 Prepayment After Acceleration.** If Mortgagee accelerates the Indebtedness following an Event of Default and Mortgagor tenders payment of the entire Indebtedness, the Yield Maintenance Premium (computed as if the payment were a voluntary prepayment on the date of tender) shall be due and payable to the extent permitted by applicable law. Mortgagor acknowledges that the Yield Maintenance Premium is bargained-for consideration for the Loan and is not a penalty, and Mortgagor waives any right to assert that the Yield Maintenance Premium is unenforceable as a penalty, forfeiture or liquidated damages provision, except to the extent such waiver is prohibited by applicable law.

**16.7 Nature of Premium.** Mortgagor acknowledges that (a) the Yield Maintenance Premium is intended to compensate Mortgagee for the loss of its investment yield caused by an early repayment of the Loan; (b) the amount of such loss is difficult and impractical to ascertain and depends upon the movement of interest rates and market conditions after the date of this Mortgage; (c) the formula set forth in **Section 16.2** is a reasonable, objective, mathematically determinate method of estimating such loss; and (d) the Yield Maintenance Premium is not a penalty or a liquidated damages provision, but is consideration for the making of the Loan.

# ARTICLE 17 — INDEMNITIES AND WAIVERS

**17.1 General Indemnity.** Mortgagor shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Mortgagee and its directors, officers, employees, agents, attorneys and successors and assigns from and against any and all losses, liabilities, damages, costs, claims, demands, penalties, judgments, causes of action and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees, expert fees and costs of investigation and defense) arising out of or relating to (a) the ownership, operation, maintenance, renovation, repair, use, occupancy, leasing or condition of the Property, including any claim by any Tenant, contractor, invitee or other Person; (b) any breach or inaccuracy of any representation, warranty, covenant or agreement of Mortgagor contained in this Mortgage or any other Loan Document; (c) any claim arising from the assertion that Mortgagor was not authorized to grant this Mortgage or to assign the Rents; (d) any construction defect, mechanic's lien claim, delay, cost overrun or other matter relating to the Project or the GC Contract; (e) any claim relating to the Land Use Restriction, the vapor barrier or the Controlled Recognized Environmental Condition described in Recital E; and (f) any act or omission of Mortgagor, any Related Entity, any Tenant or any contractor at the Property; *provided* that Mortgagor shall not be obligated to indemnify Mortgagee for losses to the extent resulting from Mortgagee's gross negligence or willful misconduct as determined by a final, non-appealable judgment.

**17.2 Environmental Indemnity.** Without limiting **Section 17.1** or **Section 7.6**, Mortgagor and Guarantor shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Mortgagee from and against all liabilities, losses, damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees and consultant fees) arising from or relating to the presence, release, threatened release, disposal or migration of Hazardous Materials at, on, under, from or migrating to or from the Property, and from any violation of or liability under any Environmental Law or the Land Use Restriction, in each case as more particularly provided in the Environmental Indemnity Agreement, which obligations shall survive repayment of the Loan, foreclosure, the acceptance of a deed in lieu of foreclosure and the release of this Mortgage.

**17.3 Duty to Defend.** Mortgagor shall, at its sole cost and expense, defend (with counsel reasonably acceptable to Mortgagee) any claim, action or proceeding covered by this Article 17, and Mortgagee may, at Mortgagor's expense, participate in the defense. Mortgagor shall not settle any such claim in a manner that adversely affects Mortgagee without Mortgagee's prior written consent.

**17.4 Waivers.** To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Mortgagor waives (a) any right to require Mortgagee to marshal assets or to proceed against any other Person or property before proceeding against the Property or any Collateral; (b) presentment, demand, protest, notice of dishonor, notice of nonpayment, notice of intention to accelerate, notice of acceleration and all other notices of any kind, except as expressly required by this Mortgage; (c) any right of appraisement, valuation, stay, extension, homestead, exemption or redemption to the extent applicable to the Property or to any sale thereof; (d) any defense based on any statute of limitations or on any claim that Mortgagee's remedies are barred or limited by any anti-deficiency or one-action rule (other than as expressly provided in **Section 18.14**); and (e) any right to assert that the Property constitutes the primary asset of Mortgagor or that any other security should be exhausted first. Mortgagor acknowledges that the waivers in this Section 17.4 are a material inducement to Mortgagee to make the Loan.

**17.5 Survival.** The indemnities, waivers and obligations in this Article 17 shall survive the closing of the Loan, the repayment of the Indebtedness, the release of this Mortgage, foreclosure and the acceptance of a deed in lieu of foreclosure.

# ARTICLE 18 — NOTICES, GOVERNING LAW AND MISCELLANEOUS

**18.1 Notices.** All notices, demands, consents, approvals, waivers and other communications under this Mortgage shall be in writing and shall be deemed duly given: (a) when delivered personally; (b) one (1) Business Day after deposit with a nationally recognized overnight courier, with charges prepaid; (c) three (3) Business Days after deposit in the United States mail, certified or registered, return receipt requested, postage prepaid; or (d) when sent by electronic mail (provided that any notice of default, acceleration or exercise of remedies sent by electronic mail shall also be sent by one of the methods described in clause (a), (b) or (c)), in each case addressed as follows:

or to such other address as a party may designate by notice given in accordance with this Section. Notice of a change of address shall be effective only upon actual receipt.

**18.2 Governing Law.** This Mortgage shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of South Carolina, without regard to principles of conflicts of law that would require the application of the laws of another jurisdiction.

**18.3 Jurisdiction and Venue.** Mortgagor irrevocably submits to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the State of South Carolina sitting in Charleston County and of the United States District Court for the District of South Carolina for the purpose of any action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Mortgage, and irrevocably waives any objection to venue in those courts and any claim that any such action or proceeding has been brought in an inconvenient forum. Nothing in this Section shall limit Mortgagee's right to bring an action in any other court of competent jurisdiction, including any court in which the Property is located or in which Mortgagor or Guarantor may be found.

**18.4 Waiver of Jury Trial.** TO THE EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, MORTGAGOR AND MORTGAGEE EACH KNOWINGLY, VOLUNTARILY AND INTENTIONALLY WAIVE ANY RIGHT TO A TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION, PROCEEDING OR COUNTERCLAIM ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS MORTGAGE, THE OTHER LOAN DOCUMENTS, THE LOAN OR THE PROPERTY. THIS WAIVER IS A MATERIAL INDUCEMENT TO MORTGAGEE TO MAKE THE LOAN, AND MORTGAGOR ACKNOWLEDGES THAT IT HAS HAD THE OPPORTUNITY TO CONSULT WITH COUNSEL REGARDING THIS WAIVER.

**18.5 Recording; Recording Taxes.** Mortgagor shall cause this Mortgage to be recorded in the RMC Office, and shall cause the UCC-1 Financing Statement to be filed with the South Carolina Secretary of State and recorded as a fixture filing in the RMC Office, in each case on or promptly after the Closing Date, and shall pay all recording fees and all South Carolina documentary stamp taxes, deed recording fees and mortgage recording fees payable in connection therewith as provided in **Section 15.7**. Mortgagor shall deliver to Mortgagee, promptly after recording, the recorded original (or a certified copy) of this Mortgage, together with evidence of the payment of all recording taxes and fees.

**18.6 No Merger; Reinstatement.** This Mortgage shall not merge into any judgment, decree of foreclosure, deed in lieu of foreclosure or other instrument, and shall remain in full force and effect until released of record by Mortgagee. If Mortgagee is required to release this Mortgage or to surrender any instrument evidencing the Indebtedness, this Mortgage and the Indebtedness shall be reinstated as provided in **Section 15.9**.

**18.7 Amendments; Entire Agreement.** This Mortgage may be amended, modified, supplemented or waived only by a written instrument signed by Mortgagor and Mortgagee. This Mortgage, together with the other Loan Documents, constitutes the entire agreement between Mortgagor and Mortgagee with respect to the Property and the Loan and supersedes all prior agreements, understandings and negotiations, whether written or oral, relating thereto (including, to the extent of any inconsistency, the Term Sheet, which this Mortgage supersedes as between the parties in accordance with Section 14.3 of the Term Sheet and **Section 1.2**).

**18.8 Successors and Assigns; No Third-Party Beneficiaries.** This Mortgage shall be binding upon and shall inure to the benefit of Mortgagor, Mortgagee and their respective permitted successors and assigns. Mortgagee may assign, sell, participate or otherwise transfer all or any portion of the Loan and this Mortgage, and Mortgagor shall cooperate with Mortgagee in connection with any such transfer, including by executing customary estoppel certificates and confirmations. Mortgagor may not assign this Mortgage or any of its rights hereunder without Mortgagee's prior written consent. No Person other than Mortgagor and Mortgagee (and Mortgagee's permitted successors and assigns) shall have any rights as a third-party beneficiary of this Mortgage, except that Guarantor shall be a third-party beneficiary of **Section 18.14**.

**18.9 Severability.** If any provision of this Mortgage is held to be invalid, illegal or unenforceable in any respect, that provision shall be enforced to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, and the invalidity, illegality or unenforceability of that provision shall not affect any other provision of this Mortgage, which shall remain in full force and effect.

**18.10 Counterparts; Electronic Signatures.** This Mortgage may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Signatures delivered by facsimile, portable document format (PDF) or other electronic means shall be deemed original signatures for all purposes, *provided* that a manually executed and acknowledged original of this Mortgage shall be delivered for recording.

**18.11 Time of the Essence.** Time is of the essence with respect to each obligation of Mortgagor under this Mortgage.

**18.12 Interpretation; No Presumption Against Drafter.** This Mortgage has been prepared by counsel for Mortgagee and reviewed by counsel for Mortgagor, and shall be construed according to the fair meaning of its terms and without any presumption against either party as the drafter. The parties acknowledge that Mortgagor has been represented by counsel of its choosing in connection with the negotiation and execution of this Mortgage.

**18.13 Lender's Regulatory Disclosures.** Mortgagee may be required under applicable law, regulation or regulatory examination or supervisory process to disclose information relating to the Loan, Mortgagor, Guarantor or the Property to its regulators, auditors, accountants, insurers, reinsurers, rating agencies, servicers, subservicers, trustees, depositories, investors, prospective assignees and participants, and Mortgagee may make such disclosures without Mortgagor's consent, *provided* that Mortgagee shall (except as required by law or in connection with a supervisory request) use commercially reasonable efforts to require the recipient to maintain the confidentiality of non-public information.

**18.14 Non-Recourse; Carve-Outs.** Except as expressly provided in this Section 18.14, Mortgagee's recourse for the payment of the Indebtedness shall be limited to the Property and the other Collateral, and Mortgagor shall not be personally liable for any deficiency. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Mortgagor shall be fully and personally liable for the entire Indebtedness (and the limitation in this Section shall be of no force or effect), and Guarantor shall be fully liable therefor under the Guaranty Agreement, if any of the following "**Carve-Out Events**" occurs: (a) fraud or intentional misrepresentation by Mortgagor, Guarantor or any Related Entity, or any breach of the representations in Section 6.12, 6.13 or 6.14; (b) misapplication or misappropriation of Rents, security deposits, insurance proceeds, Condemnation awards or Escrow Funds; (c) any voluntary petition in bankruptcy or insolvency filed by or on behalf of Mortgagor, or any collusive involuntary petition, or any action taken to authorize any of the foregoing; (d) environmental liability arising from the acts or omissions of Mortgagor, Guarantor or their respective agents, or any breach of **Section 7.6**; (e) any Transfer in violation of **Section 7.5**; and (f) any breach of the SPE Covenants in **Section 7.4**. In addition, and without making the Loan recourse generally, Mortgagor shall be liable to Mortgagee, on an "actual loss" basis (and not for the entire Indebtedness), for (i) failure to maintain the insurance required by **Article 8**, (ii) physical waste of the Property, (iii) failure to pay Impositions when due, (iv) failure to deliver Rents or other Collateral to Mortgagee as required following an Event of Default, and (v) any litigation costs or unpaid attorneys' fees described in **Section 13.11**. Nothing in this Section 18.14 shall limit (A) Mortgagee's rights against the Property, the Collateral or any guarantor, (B) any right or remedy of Mortgagee under the Environmental Indemnity Agreement, or (C) the Completion Guaranty.

**18.15 Confirmatory Instruments.** Mortgagor shall, within ten (10) Business Days after Mortgagee's written request, execute, acknowledge and deliver to Mortgagee (a) an estoppel certificate confirming the outstanding principal balance, accrued interest, the status of this Mortgage and the absence of defenses; (b) a subordination, assignment or consent required under any Lease; (c) a financing statement, continuation statement or amendment; and (d) such other instruments as Mortgagee may reasonably require to evidence, confirm or perfect its rights under the Loan Documents.

**18.16 Special South Carolina Provisions.** Mortgagor acknowledges that (a) this Mortgage is intended to be, and shall be construed as, a mortgage of real property under the laws of the State of South Carolina; (b) foreclosure shall be by judicial proceedings in accordance with **Section 13.2**, and this Mortgage grants no power of sale; (c) the Assignment of Rents set forth in **Article 5** is intended to be an absolute assignment of rents under the Uniform Assignment of Rents Act, Chapter 3, Title 29 of the South Carolina Code of Laws, as amended, and shall be enforced in accordance with that Act; (d) this Mortgage is intended to be recordable in the RMC Office, and Mortgagor shall execute and deliver such acknowledgments, affidavits, witness attestations and notarial certificates as are required for recording; and (e) to the extent any provision of this Mortgage conflicts with any non-waivable statutory right of Mortgagor under South Carolina law, such statutory right shall control, and this Mortgage shall be construed so as to preserve to Mortgagee the maximum rights and remedies permitted by law.

# ARTICLE 15 — INTEREST, FEES, LATE CHARGES AND PAYMENTS

**15.1 Payments; Interest-Only Period; Amortization.** Mortgagor shall pay the Indebtedness in accordance with the Note. Without limiting the Note, and subject to the Note in the event of any conflict: (a) the Loan shall bear interest at the Applicable Rate; (b) the Loan shall be interest-only for the first twenty-four (24) months following the Closing Date, commencing with the first Payment Date and ending on or about April 15, 2027, and during the Interest-Only Period monthly payments shall consist solely of accrued interest on the outstanding principal balance; (c) commencing with the payment due on May 15, 2027, and continuing through the Maturity Date, monthly payments of principal and interest shall be due based on a twenty-five (25) year amortization schedule, calculated on the then-outstanding principal balance and the then-applicable interest rate; (d) all payments of principal and interest shall be due on the fifteenth (15th) day of each calendar month, commencing May 15, 2025 (each, a "**Payment Date**"); and (e) the entire outstanding principal balance, together with all accrued and unpaid interest and all other amounts due under the Loan Documents, shall be due and payable on the Maturity Date.

**15.2 Interest Computation.** Interest on the Loan shall be computed on the basis of the actual number of days elapsed over a year of three hundred sixty (360) days. Interest shall accrue daily on the outstanding principal balance and shall be payable monthly in arrears on each Payment Date, at maturity, upon acceleration and upon prepayment, in each case for the period for which interest has not previously been paid. Any change in the Applicable Rate resulting from a change in Daily SOFR shall become effective on the day of such change, without notice to Mortgagor.

**15.3 Default Rate.** Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, the outstanding principal balance of the Loan and all other amounts due shall bear interest at the Default Rate, being the Applicable Rate plus five percent (5.00%) per annum, from the date of the Event of Default until the earlier of the date on which the Event of Default is cured or the Indebtedness is repaid in full. Interest at the Default Rate shall be payable on demand and shall be secured by this Mortgage. Mortgagee's imposition of the Default Rate shall not constitute a waiver of the Event of Default or an election of remedies, and the Default Rate shall continue to accrue whether or not Mortgagee has accelerated the Indebtedness.

**15.4 Late Charge.** If any installment of principal or interest, or any other amount payable under the Loan Documents, is not received by Mortgagee within ten (10) calendar days after its due date, Mortgagor shall pay to Mortgagee a late charge equal to five percent (5.00%) of the overdue amount (the "**Late Charge**"). Mortgagee may assess the Late Charge with respect to any overdue amount, and the Late Charge may be assessed more than once on the same amount if it remains overdue in more than one month. Mortgagor acknowledges and agrees that the Late Charge is intended to compensate Mortgagee for the additional administrative expense, processing cost and loss of use of funds occasioned by late payment; that the actual damages to Mortgagee from a late payment are extremely difficult and impractical to ascertain; that the Late Charge is a reasonable estimate of such damages; and that the Late Charge is not a penalty, is not interest and shall not reduce or be credited against any interest otherwise payable. The Late Charge is in addition to, and not in lieu of, the Default Rate and all other remedies.

**15.5 Application of Payments.** All payments received by Mortgagee shall be applied in such order as Mortgagee may elect and, absent such election, as provided in **Section 13.8**. Mortgagor hereby waives any right to direct the application of any payment. Any payment received after the applicable Event of Default shall be accepted without prejudice to Mortgagee's rights and may be applied as Mortgagee elects. If any payment is insufficient to pay all amounts then due, Mortgagee may apply it to any component of the Indebtedness in its discretion.

**15.6 Payments on Business Days; Manner of Payment.** If any Payment Date or other payment date is not a Business Day, the payment shall be due on the next succeeding Business Day, and interest shall continue to accrue for the intervening period. All payments shall be made in lawful money of the United States, in immediately available funds, without setoff, deduction, abatement, counterclaim or withholding, to Mortgagee at the address specified in **Section 18.1** or by wire transfer to the account designated by Mortgagee in writing.

**15.7 Fees, Costs and Expenses.** Mortgagor shall pay on the Closing Date (a) a loan origination fee equal to one percent (1.00%) of the Loan amount, in the amount of $147,500, which is fully earned upon closing and non-refundable under any circumstances; (b) all out-of-pocket costs and expenses incurred by Mortgagee in connection with the origination, underwriting, documentation, closing and administration of the Loan, including the reasonable legal fees and disbursements of Mortgagee's counsel, Fielding, Ashworth & Cole LLP; appraisal and appraisal review fees; environmental report fees; title insurance premiums and title search charges; the cost of the Survey; recording fees; UCC filing and search fees; construction inspection fees during the Project; and such other costs and expenses as Mortgagee may incur; and (c) subject to confirmation by the Title Insurer, all South Carolina documentary stamp taxes, deed recording fees and mortgage recording fees payable upon recording of this Mortgage, which, based on the rate of $1.85 per $500 of the indebtedness secured (0.37%), are estimated to be $54,575 with respect to the indebtedness of $14,750,000 secured hereby. Mortgagor shall additionally reimburse Mortgagee on demand for all such costs and expenses incurred after closing, including those described in **Section 13.11**. All such amounts shall be secured by this Mortgage and shall bear interest at the Default Rate if not paid within ten (10) days after demand.

**15.8 Interest Rate Limitation.** Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Mortgage, the Note or any other Loan Document, in no event shall the aggregate interest and other charges that are treated as interest under applicable law exceed the maximum lawful rate permitted under applicable law. If any amount in excess of the maximum lawful rate is paid, collected, charged or received, then (a) that amount shall be deemed not to have been paid or charged, shall be automatically reduced to the maximum lawful rate, and shall be refunded to Mortgagor or credited against the principal balance of the Loan as Mortgagor may elect in writing, and (b) any provision of the Loan Documents that conflicts with this Section shall be deemed reformed to the extent necessary to comply with the maximum lawful rate. To the extent permitted by applicable law, all amounts that are treated as interest shall be amortized, prorated, allocated and spread over the full period of the Loan.

**15.9 Payments Set Aside.** To the extent that any payment received by Mortgagee is subsequently invalidated, declared to be fraudulent or preferential, set aside, rescinded or required to be repaid to a trustee, receiver, debtor in possession, creditor, estate or any other Person under any bankruptcy, insolvency, fraudulent conveyance or similar law or under any equitable cause, then, to the extent of such payment, the obligation intended to be satisfied shall be revived and continue in full force and effect as if such payment had never been received, and this Mortgage shall remain in full force and effect with respect to such revived obligation.
